visual_base.visual_narrative_log:
(1) The scene is set inside a brightly lit restaurant specializing in hotpot, with steam rising from a pot on a wooden table. A man in a black t-shirt and a woman in a black and white jacket are seated. An older man in a light blue polo shirt stands behind them, holding a smartphone and a bill. The background features modern wooden dividers and other patrons.
(2) The seated man and woman begin a highly exaggerated struggle in slow motion, their faces contorted into comic expressions of determination. The man reaches for his back pocket, while the woman blocks his arm with dramatic, sweeping gestures. Red-tinted fire graphics and smoke overlays are added around them to heighten the sense of conflict.
(3) Both individuals now hold credit cards aloft, reaching desperately toward the older man’s smartphone to be the one to pay the bill. Their movements remain slow and theatrical, with the woman leaning across the table and the man pulling her arm back. The older man stands patiently in the center, looking down at his phone.
(4) The woman successfully taps her gold credit card against the waiter's phone. The dramatic lighting and fire effects disappear instantly as the video returns to normal speed. Both the man and woman break into wide smiles and laughter. The older man turns to walk away as the woman zips up her jacket.

By using cinematic slow-motion and fire effects, it parodies an action movie battle, making a mundane situation relatable and funny.
